venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.notes_summary: Bingo Tuesday went smoothly. Calm beginning, closer came in at start of Bingo with a flow of regulars and new faces. FOH made connections and informed guests of other activations. Small pop at end of night. Already had a guest visit because of beltline sign.

highlights.text: Bingo night drew regulars and new faces
Beltline signage driving new guest traffic

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Small but enthusiastic bingo crowd. Lull after bingo didn't last long — stayed steady from 9:30 through close. Some bingo coupons closed as comps rather than 'Bingo' due to missing POS discount button.
maintenance_flags: iPad 2 very quickly loses charge when not plugged in

highlights.text: POS bingo discount button not active — coupons manually comped

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Great steady start with new server in training. Beautiful weather brought patio guests. Average Tuesday evening with hectic late push. Bar and floor mostly full through 8pm then guests camped. Late groups came in around 11pm and stayed past close. Burgerville USA — everyone ordering burgers.

highlights.text: Strong training day with new server progressing well
Shannon back from golf — kitchen did great

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.notes_summary: Pretty jumping Tuesday night. First couple hours slow to fill but lots of familiar faces. Room filled around 9pm with small waitlist until 11pm. Team did great job burning and turning. Multiple guests complained about sewer smell — couple parties left after being sat. Team made best of situation.
maintenance_flags: Sewer smell persisting — guests leaving and requesting moves

highlights.text: Sewer smell continues — guests leaving after being sat
Strong guest count at 145 with good turn and burn

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Chill Tuesday AM. PM was busy from 6pm on with walk-in 9-top handled with grace by Paige & Lily. Great food sales. Two events: Exodigo day meeting (14 guests, 9am-5pm) and Castle Biosciences panel dinner (42 guests, 6:30-9:30pm) — both executed flawlessly. $16,874 total including events.

highlights.text: Well above target — $8,369 vs $5,892 target (+42.0%) excluding events
Massive event night — $8,505 event sales, $16,874 total
Outstanding hospitality — walk-in 9-top guests personally thanked MOD
